doctrines.title: 6-agent majority vote
doctrines.summary: Multiple specialized agents vote Buy/Sell/Flat; trade only on strong majority.

doctrines.title: Research before risk
doctrines.summary: Ideas from video/text should be backtested; live bot uses only proven gates.

doctrines.title: Risk agent veto
doctrines.summary: Block when opposition dominates or funding fights the trade.

doctrines.title: Strategy agent
doctrines.summary: Confluence + 3R R:R must pass before swarm can affirm.

doctrines.title: Fast vs swarm quality
doctrines.summary: When starved, slightly lower consensus; when hot, raise bar.

doctrines.title: Volume agent
doctrines.summary: Prefer symbols with real volume spike vs dead book.
